tasks.subject: Task 3: Hook revertPickupToBacklog + botón Devolver al backlog + modal
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Implementar reverso de pickup. Hook `revertPickupToBacklog(lineId)` con UPDATE atomic + WHERE clauses defensivas. Botón "Devolver al backlog" texto puro outline gris en cada item de pickup pendiente. Modal confirmación corto.

**Files:**
- Modify: src/hooks/usePickup.ts (agregar tipo + función)
- Modify: src/app/(app)/programacion/page.tsx (estado modal + handler + botón + render modal)

**Acceptance:**
- usePickup.revertPickupToBacklog(lineId) exportado
- UPDATE atomic con WHERE id AND status='Pickup Aprobado' AND pickup_completed_at IS NULL; si 0 rows → error claro
- UPDATE setea exactamente: status='Pendiente', pickup_by_project=false, pickup_approved_at=null, pickup_approved_by=null
- NO toca: pickup_completed_at/received_by_*, qty_scheduled, qty_delivered, trip_line_assignments, notes, attachments
- Botón "Devolver al backlog" texto puro, outline gris (border-gray-300 text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg)
- Posición: izquierda (secundario), "Registrar entrega" derecha (primary)
- Modal título "¿Devolver al backlog?" + body explicativo + Cancelar/Devolver
- Post-confirm: refetchPendingPickups + refetchBacklog
- npm run build verde

**Verify:** `npm run build && grep -n 'revertPickupToBacklog\|Devolver al backlog' src/hooks/usePickup.ts 'src/app/(app)/programacion/page.tsx'`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/hooks/usePickup.ts", "src/app/(app)/programacion/page.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "npm run build && grep -n 'revertPickupToBacklog' src/hooks/usePickup.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["hook implementado con WHERE defensive", "botón texto puro outline gris", "modal confirmación", "refetch dual post-confirm"]}
```
